title: One Virus Caused 15 Cruise Ship Outbreaks
hook: One stomach virus drove nearly every cruise outbreak.
closing: Crowded ships let one illness spread fast, so hygiene still shapes your trip.
question: Would an outbreak change your cruise?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20, continuing a climb that makes onboard illness harder to dismiss as rare.
Norovirus caused 15 cruise outbreaks, showing one stomach bug drives most of the problem.
Icon of the Seas holds 7,600 guests, giving one sick passenger a huge crowd to reach.
